variance: volume-weighted population variance computed with weighted Welford updates
anchor_lifetime: Each anchor starts with the bar opening exactly at its anchor and accumulates independently through the same session close.

events.cross_above_vwap: current close > current VWAP and previous close <= previous VWAP
events.cross_below_vwap: current close < current VWAP and previous close >= previous VWAP
events.exit_above_upper_2sigma: current close > current upper 2-sigma and previous close <= previous upper 2-sigma
events.exit_below_lower_2sigma: current close < current lower 2-sigma and previous close >= previous lower 2-sigma
events.reenter_from_above_2sigma: current close <= current upper 2-sigma and previous close > previous upper 2-sigma
events.reenter_from_below_2sigma: current close >= current lower 2-sigma and previous close < previous lower 2-sigma

event_validity: Two consecutive valid bars from the same anchor and session are required. Band events additionally require positive sigma on both bars. Undefined events are null.

null_rules.before_anchor: anchor values and events null; anchor_active false
null_rules.no_positive_cumulative_volume: VWAP, sigma, bands, and distances null
null_rules.first_positive_volume: VWAP equals HLC3 and sigma equals zero

availability: ts_event is bar open; bar_close_ts is exclusive bar end; available_at equals bar_close_ts
non_goals: forward returns, MFE/MAE, targets, stops, or profitability
